title: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 2
subtitle: A competition begins with a crash
summary: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 2 is Tose's Nintendo DS role-playing game following another aspiring monster scout toward a major competition. An airship journey instead ends on an unfamiliar island, leaving the protagonist to search for survivors and explore its inhabitants. Recruiting Dragon Quest creatures again provides the team that fights on his behalf. body: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 2 is Tose's Nintendo DS role-playing game following another aspiring monster scout toward a major competition. An airship journey instead ends on an unfamiliar island, leaving the protagonist to search for survivors and explore its inhabitants. Recruiting Dragon Quest creatures again provides the team that fights on his behalf. The interrupted journey gives the collection another immediate purpose: a capable group of monsters is needed to move through the island, understand what has happened and prepare for the challenges awaiting beyond the first safe area.

The team still has three spaces, but new large and gargantuan creatures can occupy two or all three of them. Choosing one changes the shape of the entire group, trading a larger individual presence against the flexibility of several smaller companions. Players can issue direct battle commands or choose tactics for the monsters to follow. The human scout supports them with items. Size therefore becomes a practical part of preparing the party, giving another reason to think about how its members work together before the next turn-based encounter begins.

The Japanese Professional edition added further monsters, regions and abilities while retaining the main story, extending the same island adventure rather than replacing its premise. The original game also supported direct multiplayer battles, giving a developed team another kind of opponent. Exploring, recruiting and preparing remain closely connected: an unfamiliar creature can become a useful addition, while a new arrangement may make another part of the island easier to approach. The sequel develops that cycle through the changed party sizes and the opportunities offered by its interrupted journey.
